metadata.title: आदिवासी आक्रोश क्यों | Why Adivasi protested on Unity Day | Ho Tribe
metadata.description: On the day the government celebrated National Unity Day, hundreds of people from the Ho tribe gathered at Jantar Mantar, New Delhi, demanding the inclusion of the Ho language in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution. The Ho community, spread across Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and several other states, has been struggling for years to get constitutional recognition for their language. This marks their fifth major protest in recent years — a powerful reminder that while India talks of unity, many tribal voices are still fighting to preserve their identity, language, and culture.
